## Selected Projects

### 1. KV-Cache Fabric
- **Description**: Disaggregated memory system for LLM agent swarms.
- **Tech Stack**: Go, Rust, gRPC.
- **Architecture**: VRAM-to-DRAM tiering, concurrent radix-tree prefix caching, race-free two-phase eviction.
- **Results**:
  - 53% lower time-to-first-token on partial cache hits
  - 99.3% prefix-cache reuse in multi-agent benchmarks
  - Zero deadlocks or OOM errors in a 16-concurrent-agent eviction stress test

### 2. CodeSentry
- **Description**: Zero-dependency DevSecOps & AI code inspection engine (self-hosted alternative to CodeRabbit).
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/kaunteyaarjun/code_inspection_tool
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, Python AST, Node.js (>=18), OpenRouter AI, GitHub Actions.
- **Role**: Lead Developer (Team of 4).
- **Features**: Multi-language AST taint analysis (JS, TS, Python), AutoGrad continuous risk grading with offline self-learning memory, DeployGuard pre-deployment gates, and ModelShield LLM/RAG defense. 97 tests passing across 30 suites. Zero Docker required.

### 3. AI-Based Loan Disbursement System
- **Description**: AI-driven loan eligibility scoring and disbursement workflow automation.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Scikit-Learn.
- **Features**: Real-time risk scoring, transparent credit decisioning, idempotent automated disbursement pipeline.

### 4. Pole Studios (https://polestudios.in)
- **Description**: Branding and web development studio delivering commercial websites and digital products.
- **Founded**: October 2025. Operating on zero external capital.
